notes.title: Listen to the wind Patch Note 0.98c
notes.notes:
BugFix:
1. Fixed the problem of screen tearing of some transition animations.

Features:
1. The game supports English language now. You can change the language in the game setting.
2. Added A new animation telling the heroine's story. It can be unlocked and viewed in the “Achievements-CG” after completing the corresponding battle.
3. Added English and Traditional Chinese description for Steam achievement.

Optimization: 
1. Adjusted the play speed of some of the transitional animations.
2. Adjusted the description of some achievements.
